scope: Historical incomplete external preparation; zero regression bodies executed; no current execution credit

complete_original_status.independently_confirmed_source_defect: try_home_states samples the remaining duration before process identity and token validation, then send_request_for_digest_detailed reconstructs a new absolute deadline after that work. The validation interval can therefore extend the client's internal deadline. Successful immediate and outer-lease returns also need to remain within the original caller deadline.
complete_original_status.relationship_to_failed_linux_startup: Separate source-level finding; the two retained fail-closed Linux startup errors do not establish this defect as their cause.
intended_repair_not_applied: Pass the original Instant through discovered-state identity/token validation and the client exchange.
Preserve the existing 250 ms authentication phase, protocol/authentication/binding validation and fatal versus unavailable result.
Fence only otherwise successful completions against the same original absolute deadline, including after ordinary one-shot lease cleanup.
Never reclassify a committed ambiguous exchange as replay-safe; preserve original errors verbatim.
preparation_only: A test-only barrier was added after real discovered-state identity and token validation in the temporary checkout.
Two small helper/test files were prepared while retaining the original stale-duration behavior so a before-repair run could demonstrate the defect.

The included test body is the exact pre-rustfmt version. The formatted body and instrumented managed_resident.rs are unavailable; their recorded hashes are listed in available-missing-byte-inventory.json.
The helper and test are incomplete patch fragments, not an applied or buildable production repair.
planned_real_socket_controls: Hold the real discovered-state path after identity/token validation until its original deadline; require no connection or request.
Release the same barrier while the original deadline remains live; require one complete authenticated, request-bound exchange.
Hold after a real authenticated response on the leased path; reject a success returned after the original deadline without replay.
Hold the one-shot path before its ordinary lease cleanup; reject a late success under the original deadline.
Preserve the original fatal authentication error even when cleanup crosses the deadline.
complete_original_status.evidence_limit: The retained output is a tool-returned compile excerpt and kernel/memory tail, not a byte-verified full original before.log or complete kernel log.
complete_original_status.causal_limit: The workspace reset followed the kernel OOM event. The provider's reason for replacing the sandbox is not established by these records.
